Text: LLM-as-Judge Evaluation Frameworks for Agents

Evaluating agent outputs manually doesn’t scale. 

LLM-as-Judge uses another LLM to score and evaluate agent responses based on defined rubrics, making evaluation faster and more consistent.

This is becoming essential as more teams run large-scale agent evaluations.

As a dev, I now use LLM-as-Judge for most agent evaluations.

LLM-as-Judge Cheatsheet:

Define clear evaluation rubrics

Use LLM to score outputs on multiple dimensions

Get explanations along with scores

Combine with human review for critical cases

Track evaluation scores over time

Pro tip: Start with simple rubrics and gradually add more evaluation criteria
